integrity: All formulae have an analytic proof; finite numerical diagnostics are not treated as infinite certificates. Historical priority has residual unindexed-literature uncertainty. No independent audit has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers only the unique optimally A-stable real truncated-trapezoidal symbol at each integer order at least two; it does not imply an operator-valued convolution quadrature convergence theorem. The computational checks at finitely many orders are supplementary to the analytic proof.
title: All-order alternating-coefficient theorem for optimized truncated-trapezoidal symbols
